basics.name: Luis Angel Gutierrez Bonillo
basics.label: Software, Data & AI Engineer | Digital Transformation for Oil & Gas
basics.summary: Systems Engineer with over 4 years of experience building enterprise software, data solutions and AI, with a focus on the oil industry. For PDVSA (Petrodelta and ESEM) I developed document management and project portfolio systems with roles, costs, tracking and automated reports, deployed on-premise. I created PetroAtlas, an open source oil well explorer with a map, production and pressure series, LAS logs, Arps decline, IPR, PVT and Chan diagnostics, and published its calculation library on npm with over 90% coverage. I design applied AI solutions (RAG, agents, on-premise LLMs) and have trained staff at oil companies in AI and data analysis with R. Currently pursuing a Master's degree in Management Informatics with research on local AI for decision-making. Available for on-site work in eastern Venezuela or remote.

projects.name: PetroAtlas – Open Source Oil Well Explorer
projects.description: Open source web application (MIT) for exploring oil wells with synthetic data from Venezuela: interactive map, well cards, production and pressure series, logs, engineering tools and in-browser analysis (2026, personal project).
highlights: TypeScript monorepo with Next.js (App Router), Express 5, PostgreSQL + PostGIS, MapLibre GL and ECharts; read-only REST API and a reproducible Docker Compose environment.
npm library @suricatoaviones/petro-calc published: Arps decline, forecasting and EUR, Vogel IPR, Standing PVT and Chan diagnostics, with over 90% coverage.
Browser-based CSV and LAS file import and validation with IndexedDB, without sending data to the server: a pattern applicable to confidential field information.
Synchronized time series, well trajectory, track-based logs, threshold alerts and comparison of up to eight wells.
Quality: strict TypeScript, Zod, Vitest, Playwright, axe audit (WCAG), GitHub Actions CI and a bilingual Spanish/English interface.
Deployed on Render; architecture documentation, ADRs and data model.
